source.note: v1.3: denser signature skills after skill-dictionary expansion (Hibernate, Argo CD, Power BI, RAG, …). Optional signature group = OR (max weight).

notes: Signature skill names must match skill_dictionary.canonical_name; unknown skills are skipped at seed.
Optional signature field group: same group_key = OR (max weight); empty group = required AND.
Soft-skill roles (Product, Design, Manual QA) stay lighter on tech weights; scorers dampen thin roles.
